I was having a few issues with the script for my use cases, so I got AI to fork it and make some adjustments/fixes (which also addresses the issue Boldacity [[Please login to see this link.]] pointed out).

Fork: [[Please login to see this link.]]

Changelog:

Spoiler
Infinite scroll / pagination
  • Replaced :contains('N').next().next() sibling-based page resolution with parseTotalPages(), buildPageLinkMap(), derivePageStep(), startOffsetOf() and resolvePageLink().
  • Fixed page-number substring matching, such as page 2 also matching pages 20, 21 and 22.
  • Fixed pagination separator elements breaking the expected sibling ordering.
  • Page numbers are now read from each numbered anchor’s displayed text instead of calculated from its start= offset.
  • The per-page offset step is derived from numbered pagination links instead of being hardcoded, supporting different pagination sizes across topics, forum listings, search results and private messages.
  • Fixed topic pagination using 15 posts per page being assigned incorrect page numbers by the previous hardcoded 100-item offset assumption.
  • Page 1 links without a start= parameter are handled correctly.
  • The total page count is parsed from the supplied pagination content first, then td.nav or .nav elements, then the document body as a final fallback.
  • If the total cannot be parsed, it falls back to whichever is higher: the current page or the highest visible numbered page.
  • Added support for long threads where the next page exists but is outside the currently visible pagination window.
  • Forward loading stops at the known total page count, enforced both before requesting the next page and when synthesising missing pagination URLs.
  • Backward page URLs can be synthesised when the per-page offset step can be derived.
  • Added an explicit stop when the backward target would be below page 1.
  • Current, earliest and latest page values are now handled as numbers instead of page-number strings.
  • Added getCurrentBoldPageNumber() to select the active bold element containing only a page number, ignoring other bold navigation text.
  • Loaded content is assigned its known target page number directly.
  • Added a validity check before using a post block’s stored page_number value.
  • Added separate tracking of the last forward and backward start= offsets.
  • Prevents requesting the same clamped start= offset twice consecutively in either direction.
  • Stops forward loading when a fetched page contains no matching posts, topics or messages.
  • Added a forwardExhausted latch to prevent repeated requests after the final page is reached.
  • Refreshes the known total page count from each newly fetched full page.
  • Checks that cached navigation HTML exists before restoring it.
  • Added null checks before modifying the topic page-number indicator.
  • Added null checks before cloning the end-of-thread navigation table or editing its page-number elements.
  • Resets scrollLength when a backward request is refused, preventing the next valid backward scroll from triggering prematurely.

Crash guards
  • mentionify() skips post blocks missing the post-name anchor or profile anchor instead of throwing and aborting the remaining per-page functions.
  • addLink() skips post blocks without a valid post anchor instead of throwing while extracting the post ID.
  • dynamicFunction() returns after starting its asynchronous self-fetch instead of continuing with undefined page data.
  • dynamicFunction() checks that the forum time display, online-user list and private-message link exist before updating them.
  • New-message colourisation only runs when the private-message link exists.
  • colorizeFriendsMe() checks that the friend-legend container exists before appending the “Friends” link.

Performance
  • startUpdating() clears any existing refresh interval before creating another one, preventing multiple 60-second timers from stacking after repeated tab visibility changes.
  • colorizeFriendsMe() marks processed elements with a data attribute and skips them on later scans, so dynamic refreshes and infinite-scroll loads only colour newly added usernames, authors, quotes and links.

Other
  • Removed the leading “@” from mentions created through the full-reply path.
  • Removed the leading “@” from mentions created through the quick-reply path.
